summary: Derive the equilibrium frequency ladder, assemble one L/J-pole matrix per frequency, and select fluid kx branches.

capability: Derive the equilibrium frequency ladder, assemble one L/J-pole matrix per frequency, and select fluid kx branches.
operation: scan fluid kx branches over the frequency ladder
SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to fluid kx spectra
discovery.model: homogeneous magnetized Maxwellian multi-species fluid pole model
discovery.boundary: J is 8 or 12 and L-pole tables exist only through harmonic 7; every frequency must be nonzero

identity.relation: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to fluid kx spectra
identity.direction: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to fluid kx spectra
identity.definition: The graph derives kn and wn from one species equilibrium, builds (omega_scale:omega_step:omega_stop)*wn and kz_scale*kn, and independently solves kx X=M(omega,kz)X at each frequency.
identity.model: homogeneous magnetized Maxwellian multi-species fluid pole model
identity.coordinates: wavevector x-z plane, z parallel to B0; frequency is an ordered scan axis
identity.boundary: J is 8 or 12 and L-pole tables exist only through harmonic 7; every frequency must be nonzero
assumptions: All species controls describe one shared equilibrium snapshot.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: Mass of each species, entering the thermal speed and cyclotron frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite positive masses, one value per species.

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Charge of each species, setting the sign of the cyclotron frequency and coupling terms
inputs.constraints: Finite nonzero charges, one value per species.

inputs.name: ns_unit
inputs.description: Density of each species relative to the reference density
inputs.constraints: Finite positive density ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: Ts_unit
inputs.description: Temperature of each species relative to the reference temperature
inputs.constraints: Finite positive temperature ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Background magnetic-field strength, setting the cyclotron-frequency scale

inputs.name: T00
inputs.constraints: Finite positive reference temperature in eV.

inputs.name: omega_scale
inputs.description: Start fraction of the scan frequency ladder (0.05 in the source implementation); multiplied by the wn derived internally by this graph to give the absolute start frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite scan start; every derived angular frequency must be nonzero.

inputs.name: omega_step
inputs.description: Equal-step fraction of the scan frequency ladder (0.05 in the source implementation); multiplied by the wn derived internally by this graph to give the absolute step

inputs.name: omega_stop
inputs.description: Stop multiple of the scan frequency ladder (3.95 in the source implementation); together with the start and step it defines the source's colon expression, from which the number of scan frequencies follows
inputs.constraints: Finite scan endpoint not below the start.

inputs.name: kz_scale
inputs.description: Parallel wavenumber relative to kn, giving the kz used by the scan

inputs.name: max_harmonic
inputs.description: Maximum Bessel harmonic order N, setting the number of matrix blocks
inputs.constraints: Integer from 0 through 7, limited by the frozen L-pole tables.

inputs.name: j_order
inputs.description: Z-pole order J, selecting the pole table and setting each species' pole-block size
inputs.constraints: Integer 8 or 12, selecting a frozen Z-pole table.

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: Number of leading branches returned per frequency

outputs.name: scales
outputs.description: Per-species scales derived from the equilibrium inputs and consumed by both assembly and the eigensolve
outputs.units: mixed (each key carries its own unit)
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kn
outputs.description: Wavenumber normalization scale derived internally by this graph, kn=1/max|rho_cs|, returned as a top-level physical quantity
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: wn
outputs.description: Frequency normalization scale derived internally by this graph, wn=min|w_cs|, returned as a top-level physical quantity
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: omegas
outputs.description: Scan angular-frequency axis derived internally by this graph, xx=(omega_scale:omega_step:omega_stop)*wn, which is the xx vector stored by the source implementation
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Number of frequencies derived from the source's colon-style (omega_scale:omega_step:omega_stop) ladder
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kx_spectra
outputs.description: Complete kx spectrum at each frequency
outputs.shape: (F,) object array of full complex spectra
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kx_selected
outputs.description: Branches at each frequency that pass the real-part threshold, sorted in ascending |Im| order
outputs.shape: (F,) object array of variable-length complex branches
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kx_head
outputs.description: First keep branches at each frequency, forming the scan curves
outputs.shape: (F,) object array of variable-length complex branches
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kz
outputs.description: Parallel wavenumber actually used by this scan
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: matrix_sizes
outputs.description: Matrix order and number of nonzero entries at each frequency
outputs.shape: (F,) object array of (matrix order, nonzero count) tuples
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: graph_order
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

preconditions: J is 8 or 12 and L-pole tables exist only through harmonic 7; every frequency must be nonzero
supported: Derive the equilibrium frequency ladder, assemble one L/J-pole matrix per frequency, and select fluid kx branches.
excluded: No unrequested mode identity or accuracy guarantee is inferred.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: The first invalid graph control or dependency input raises ValueError; no partial result mapping is returned.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency numerical errors propagate without fallback; solver diagnostics remain observable where returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No graph feedback loop is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: scan_fluid_wavevectors(ms, qs, ns_unit, Ts_unit, B0, n00, T00, omega_scale, omega_step, omega_stop, kz_scale, max_harmonic, j_order, keep=5)

example.description: Run a one-point normalized fluid scan and check its terminal mapping.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import scan_fluid_wavevectors
r=scan_fluid_wavevectors(ms=[9.1094e-31],qs=[-1.60217662e-19],ns_unit=[1],Ts_unit=[1],B0=1,n00=6.075e19,T00=1000,omega_scale=0.5,omega_step=0.05,omega_stop=0.5,kz_scale=0.1,max_harmonic=0,j_order=8); assert r['count']==1
example.expected: Observed PASS: the bounded scan produces one frequency sample, one spectrum entry, and the declared seven-node graph order.

edges.description: Speed of light squared enters the Maxwell curl term
Vacuum permittivity enters the Ampere-law source term
Plasma-frequency squared is a common factor of all coupling terms
Signed cyclotron frequency enters the resonance denominator
Thermal speed enters the parallel-resonance argument
Signed gyroradius and pole scaling together determine the velocity blocks
The gyroradius sign enters the xz and yz coupling terms
The absolute gyroradius scales the L-pole coefficients
L-pole residues give the rational weights of the Bessel terms
L-pole locations give the rational denominators of the Bessel terms
The number of poles at each order sets the velocity-block dimension
Z-pole residues set the resonance weights
Z-pole locations set the resonance locations
The eigenproblem is defined only for the fully assembled matrix
The real-part threshold is expressed in the scan wavenumber normalization scale
The scan parallel wavenumber is scaled by the same normalization scale and then enters the resonance argument and the Maxwell curl term
The scan frequency axis is scaled by wn derived from the equilibrium; the axis is derived by this graph rather than supplied by the caller
The per-frequency scan axis enters matrix assembly; each frequency is assembled independently, and the axis is the xx vector stored by the source implementation
